abstract: OBJECTIVE: We sought to investigate the reproductive outcomes of women who underwent laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratoma with or without intraoperative spillage. STUDY DESIGN: The reproductive outcomes of reproductive age women following laparoscopic removal of benign cystic teratoma from 1997 through 2007 were investigated by a telephone questionnaire. RESULTS: In all, 128 reproductive age women underwent benign cystic teratoma removal, and reproductive outcomes were available for 45. Among those 45 women, intraoperative spillage occurred in 16 (35.6%). The rate of spontaneous pregnancies was significantly lower for the nonspillage compared to the intraoperative spillage groups (20/29 [68.9%] vs 16/16 [100%], respectively; P = .01). However, the median time from surgery to the first pregnancy was similar (22 and 18.5 months, respectively; P = .9). From the 9 remaining women in the nonspillage group, 4 conceived with ovulation induction, 2 conceived with in vitro fertilization, and 3 were infertile. CONCLUSION: Intraoperative spillage of benign cystic teratomas does not lead to long-term infertility.
abstract_ja: 目的：腹腔鏡下で良性嚢胞性奇形腫を切除した女性について、術中の内容物漏出の有無にかかわらず、生殖転帰を調べること。研究デザイン：1997年から2007年に腹腔鏡下で良性嚢胞性奇形腫の除去を受けた生殖年齢の女性の生殖転帰を、電話による質問票で調査した。結果：生殖年齢の女性128例が良性嚢胞性奇形腫の切除を受け、転帰が得られたのは45例であった。このうち16例(35.6%)で術中の漏出が生じた。自然妊娠率は、漏出なし群と比べて漏出あり群で有意に高かった（20/29 [68.9%] 対 16/16 [100%]、P = .01）。ただし、手術から初回妊娠までの中央値期間は両群で類似していた（それぞれ22か月、18.5か月；P = .9）。漏出なし群の残り9例のうち、4例は排卵誘発により、2例は体外受精により妊娠し、3例は不妊であった。結論：良性嚢胞性奇形腫の術中漏出は、長期的な不妊をもたらさない。
